title: A 24 unit artboard rules itself into units
goal: The icon drawing mock rules a 24 unit artboard into its units so you can see where a point will land. In the app the frame shows keylines but no units, and turning the Grid on draws lines four units apart that ignore the frame.
notes: REPRODUCED 2026-11-05: queue/manager/shots/2026-11-05-walks/m7.json, action showGrid on a 24 frame, picture queue/manager/shots/2026-11-05-grid-on-24-unit-frame.png: lines about 218 pixels apart on a frame of about 1310, so 4 units, drawn across the whole canvas. Whole-unit snapping itself works (IconSnap.swift). Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/icon-draw-wt.html, 'the quiet 24 unit grid' and the Grid & snap group. The grid stays in the View menu: that was settled by the card on 2026-10-20 and the placement contract row for the View menu, so add no control. Objective icon-grid success line 1. The canvas grid's level-of-detail ladder is in UX-PATTERNS D16; the units are the frame's own, not a second grid setting.
acceptance: With the Grid on over a 24 unit icon frame or icon picture, one quiet line falls on every unit inside the artboard, starting from its corner, at any zoom where the lines are at least 6 screen points apart
MEASURED, and today's window fails it: in a crop of a 24 unit artboard at fit zoom, 23 evenly spaced lines cross it each way (today 5, four units apart)
The lines sit under the keylines and read quieter than them in light and dark, as the mock draws them, and the grid outside the artboard is unchanged
Whether the units show without the Grid switched on is decided against icon-draw-wt.html and written in the audit

Try path: New Frame, 24, View, Show Grid. A walk photographs it beside the mock, and Audit written under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not
